description: Ten saved primary-analysis epidemic/protection pairs, reused from slide 25 to illustrate scenario-specific optimal dates.
calendar_alignment: Each protection curve is shifted to its own scenario-optimal vaccination week. The matching red dot marks the dose date, before the saved immune-response delay.
regret_definition: Remaining burden at a candidate date minus the minimum remaining burden in that same scenario.
closing_question: Could forecasts help choose among these dates?
